topography.project_purpose: Structural profile: 33 project-authored contract(s) across 6 chain(s); 4 ERC20 tokens, 3 ERC721 NFTs; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 4 common project-authored base contract(s) (proxy, erc1967upgrade, administrable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
